name: Google
description: Google's products from the search box of 1997 to Gemini, including the ones it shut down.

checkpoints.name: Search
checkpoints.note: Two Stanford students build a search engine that ranks pages by the links pointing to them. Within a few years it is the front door of the web.

checkpoints.name: Mail, maps and video
checkpoints.note: Gmail arrives in 2004 with far more storage than its rivals, Google Maps follows in 2005, and in 2006 the company buys YouTube.

checkpoints.name: Android and Chrome
checkpoints.note: Android and the Chrome browser both arrive in 2008 and both become the most used in the world. The social networks Buzz and Google+ do less well.

checkpoints.name: AI first
checkpoints.note: AlphaGo beats one of the world's best Go players in 2016, and a 2017 paper by Google researchers describes the transformer, the design behind today's chatbots. Reader, Google+ and Stadia are among the products closed along the way.
